title: SIEVE: Selective attention-value Suppression for Vision-Language Models Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2610.01962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to associate visual identities with biographical information creates a need for selective unlearning of personally identifiable information (PII) while preserving permitted knowledge about the same individual. This setting is challenging because both sensitive and retained information can share the same visual inputs and intermediate representations. We introduce SIEVE, a simple and effective framework for selective VLM unlearning. SIEVE directly regularizes attention-value representations while also controlling model outputs. SIEVE suppresses attention values for forget examples toward a constant zero, while preserving retain-example representations by matching them to a frozen reference model. These objectives are combined with sequence-level forget and retain supervision, enabling targeted forgetting without largely affecting retained knowledge. translated_title: SIEVE：面向视觉-语言模型遗忘的选择性注意力值抑制
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够将视觉身份与个人信息相关联，这产生了在保留同一被许可知识的同时、选择性遗忘个人身份信息（PII）的需求。这一设定极具挑战性，因为敏感信息与需保留的信息可能共享相同的视觉输入和中间表示。我们提出了 SIEVE，一个简单而有效的选择性视觉-语言模型遗忘框架。SIEVE 直接对注意力值表示进行正则化，同时控制模型输出。SIEVE 将遗忘样本的注意力值抑制为恒定的零，同时通过将保留样本的表示与冻结的参考模型进行匹配来保护它们。这些目标与序列级别的遗忘和保留监督相结合，实现了有针对性的遗忘，而不会大幅影响被保留的知识。大量实验表明，SIEVE 能够……
tldr: SIEVE 提出了一个简单有效的视觉-语言模型选择性遗忘框架，通过将遗忘样本的注意力值抑制为零，并结合冻结参考模型来保护保留样本的表示，从而在保留合法知识的同时精准遗忘个人身份信息。
en_tdlr: SIEVE is a simple and effective selective unlearning framework for vision-language models that suppresses attention values of forget examples to zero while preserving retained knowledge by matching retain representations to a frozen reference model.
